coach.reply:
Yes
The task force is well-sized and balanced for the work without ceremonial bloat. The five roles map directly to essential lean TDD responsibilities: design and corpus generation, test writing, implementation, adversarial review, and independent sign-off. Work is sensibly matched to model tiers, deploying mid-tier models for mechanical tasks (red test writing and sign-off gating) while reserving strong-tier seats for slice architecture and adversarial testing. Contexts remain distinct to avoid cross-contamination. Refinement rightly evaluated and declined an extra domain-expert seat given existing reference material and available quota.

CITE: each role's service and exact model pinned before any seat runs
